import argparse
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


TRUNCATED_MARKER = "\n... [truncated]"
TRUNCATE_AT = 50000


def _find_runtime():
    for name in ("podman", "docker"):
        if shutil.which(name) is not None:
            return name
    raise RuntimeError("Neither podman nor docker is installed on this host")


def sandbox_run(
    command: str,
    workspace: str | None = None,
    image: str = "debian:stable-slim",
    timeout: int = 60,
    network: str = "none",
    memory: str = "2g",
    pids: int = 512,
    cpus: float = 2.0,
) -> str:
    runtime = _find_runtime()

    argv = [
        runtime, "run", "--rm", "--pull=missing",
        "--network=" + network,
        "--memory=" + memory,
        "--pids-limit=" + str(pids),
        "--cpus=" + str(cpus),
        "--cap-drop=ALL",
        "--security-opt=no-new-privileges",
    ]

    if workspace is not None:
        argv += ["-v", workspace + ":/workspace:rw", "-w", "/workspace"]

    argv += [image, "sh", "-c", command]

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            argv,
            capture_output=True,
            timeout=timeout,
            shell=False,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return "exit=124\n--- stdout ---\n--- stderr ---\n"

    stdout_bytes = result.stdout
    stderr_bytes = result.stderr

    combined = stdout_bytes + stderr_bytes
    if len(combined) > TRUNCATE_AT:
        kept = TRUNCATE_AT - len(TRUNCATED_MARKER.encode())
        stdout_bytes = stdout_bytes[:kept]
        stdout_decoded = stdout_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") + TRUNCATED_MARKER
        stderr_decoded = ""
    else:
        stdout_decoded = stdout_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        stderr_decoded = stderr_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    return (
        f"exit={result.returncode}\n"
        f"--- stdout ---\n"
        f"{stdout_decoded}"
        f"--- stderr ---\n"
        f"{stderr_decoded}"
    )


def _main():
    argv = sys.argv[1:]

    if "--" in argv:
        idx = argv.index("--")
        sandbox_args = argv[:idx]
        command_args = argv[idx + 1:]
    else:
        command_args = None
        for i, arg in enumerate(argv):
            if not arg.startswith("-") and i > 0:
                command_args = argv[i:]
                sandbox_args = argv[:i]
                break

    if command_args is None:
        command_args = argv

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="sandbox",
        description="Run a command inside an ephemeral, isolated container.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--image", default="debian:stable-slim")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--network", default="none", choices=["none", "bridge"])
    parser.add_argument("--memory", default="2g")
    parser.add_argument("--pids", type=int, default=512)
    parser.add_argument("--cpus", type=float, default=2.0)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", default=None)

    args = parser.parse_args(sandbox_args)

    if not command_args:
        parser.print_help()
        sys.exit(1)

    cmd_str = " ".join(command_args)

    workspace = args.workspace if args.workspace else os.getcwd()

    output = sandbox_run(
        command=cmd_str,
        workspace=workspace,
        image=args.image,
        timeout=args.timeout,
        network=args.network,
        memory=args.memory,
        pids=args.pids,
        cpus=args.cpus,
    )

    print(output, end="")

    exit_match = output.split("\n", 1)[0]
    if exit_match.startswith("exit="):
        try:
            sys.exit(int(exit_match.split("=")[1]))
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    _main()
